backlogged.summary: A reason that starts with '-' (for example "-5% fixed") is rejected as an unknown option by parseClose in lib/commands/backlog.mjs. The user has to rephrase the reason. This matches ES-1 (unknown option), so it is a usability note, not a defect.
lintContract prints 'already closed as undefined' when a hand-edited `closed` value is not an object with a string `as`. The `closed` check in backlog close handles that case, but lint does not.
The change to test/f81-verify-phases.test.mjs (waiting for the other feature's commit) is timing stabilization outside the F95 scope. It is similar to open backlog item B484, which is about F97.
